description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_user_role_data_group' database table and handling permissions related to data groups for user roles.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions associated with data groups for user roles, including read, create, update, delete, and self permissions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Checks if the permission is self-referential.

methods.name: setDataGroup
methods.description: Associates a DataGroup entity with this permission.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.
